newsitem.title: USA: Miller Brewing aims ad campaign at Texas market.
newsitem.headline: Miller Brewing aims ad campaign at Texas market.

text.p: Continuing its heavy advertising push, Philip Morris Cos Inc's Miller Brewing Co next week begins an ad campaign for its Miller Lite brand aimed specifically at the Texas market.
The series of five new Miller Lite spots, featuring the "Miller Time" ad theme, aims at capitalizing on the brand's strength in the Texas market.
"Texas beer drinkers are unique," Mike Johnson, Miller Lite brand director, said in a statement. "So we needed an advertising campaign that celebrated Texans' idea of Miller Time."
The integrated marketing campaign features real Texans and includes TV, radio, outdoor advertising, promotions, packaging and other initiatives, the company said.

The campaign was created by Miller Lite's lead agency, Fallon McElligott, Minneapolis, in conjunction with Square One, Dallas, another Miller roster agency for the Milwaukee's Best and High Life brands.
